promotion_policy.data_policy: 638 server-approved feedback annotations plus leakage-safe historical replay; exact image SHA groups never cross train, validation, and test; accepted model predictions are train-only low-weight stability examples.
promotion_policy.outer_strategy: Robust card-silhouette segmentation trained with human corrections, historical replay, gray cast-shadow, sleeve-edge, glare, exposure and blur hard negatives; followed by a high-resolution four-side strip refiner and validation-selected zero-margin geometry gate.
promotion_policy.outer_fallback: The physical-edge and geometry validation fallbacks remain active. Low-quality or unresolved results are routed to review rather than converted into fixed coordinates.
promotion_policy.inner_strategy: Seven-channel V5 four-side refiner with robust luminance/gradient inputs, source-balanced hard-example replay and edge-specific loss weighting. The gate was fitted only on the validation split and the top-left specialist remains a conservative fallback for logo/title interference.
rejected_experiments: A second directed V5 fine-tune improved feedback metrics but regressed the historical test set, so it was not promoted.
Adaptive photometric rescue changed no coordinates in the new candidate and increased latency, so it remains disabled.
A V4 feedback-only inner refiner was more aggressive on the new feedback set but slightly regressed history, so the balanced V5 model was selected.

validation_evidence.known_residual_risk: Very dark mixed blur/noise/JPEG inputs remain review-worthy; synthetic mixed-low-quality P95 regressed and is intentionally not hidden by an unconditional rescue route.

models.role: Feedback-trained robust outer card-silhouette segmentation model
Feedback-trained high-resolution four-side outer-frame strip refiner
Outer segmentation fallback for unusual small targets
Feedback-trained robust seven-channel four-side inner-frame refiner
Top-left specialist for logo and high-contrast interference
